name: wine cellar
description: a cool, dark room lined with racks of wine bottles, many caked with dust and cobwebs. a few have broken, their contents long since evaporated, leaving only dark stains on the stone floor. in the corner, a small table holds a single, unlit candle. the air is cool and smells of wine and ancient mold.

items.name: wine_bottle
items.description: a dusty bottle of vintage wine. the label reads 'blackwood reserve 1882'. it might still be drinkable. the cork is intact.

items.name: candle_21efe917
items.description: a short, unused tallow candle on the table. it has never been lit.

items.name: brass_key_2
items.description: a small brass key on the floor near the table, half-hidden in shadow. it's identical to the one from the graveyard.

items.name: wine_case
items.description: a wooden case containing six bottles of rare port, all intact. worth a fortune to a collector.

items.name: water_carboy
items.description: a large glass carboy of drinking water, half full. the glass stopper is still sealed with wax. the water inside is perfectly clear.

items.name: hidden_shelf
items.description: one of the wine racks is shallower than the others. behind it, a small recess holds a single leather-bound book. the title: 'rituals of binding and release.'

items.name: ritual_book
items.description: a leather-bound grimoire titled 'rituals of binding and release'. the marked page describes how to release a spirit bound to a crystal skull: return the skull to the place of death (the altar in the crypt), speak the name of the bound spirit at midnight, and break the skull. 'but be warned — the spirit released may not be the one you intended to free.'

exits.description: a heavy door with a rusted brass lock. the wood is warped with age and damp.
